summary: Retested tab layout at 8 viewport widths (360,390,768,900,1100,1280,1440,1920) on /songcoder.html with cache-bust. 7/8 widths pass equal-width (within 1px) requirement. Only W=768 fails: Catalog tab is 120.00px vs other 5 tabs ~118.38-118.39px (1.62px diff). All other criteria pass: no page horizontal overflow at any width; tabs container scrollWidth == clientWidth at all widths; display=grid with '136px x6' at >=1281 (1440, 1920); display=flex single-row at <=1280; 6 tabs visible everywhere; active indicator (#tab-ind) tracks clicks (indL=580.66 vs actL=582 after clicking Artists at 1440 ~1.34px off, acceptable). Tab click switched to Artists view correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Catalog tab width is 120.00px while other 5 tabs are 118.38-118.39px (delta 1.62px, exceeds 1px tolerance). The min-width:0;overflow:hidden fix from iteration_9 did not fully equalize at exactly 768px. The '56' badge inside Catalog likely still contributes intrinsic min-content. At 900+ (flex) it equalizes correctly; at 1281+ (grid) exactly 136px.

action_items: At 768px, make Catalog tab width equal to siblings. The current flex:1 with min-width:0;overflow:hidden isn't enough because inner badge pushes content width. Options: add flex-basis:0 explicitly to .tab, or set width:0 on inner badge/label wrappers, or use grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr) also in the 761-1280 breakpoint instead of flex, to guarantee perfectly equal columns regardless of content.
critical_code_review_comments: Measured getBoundingClientRect widths at W=768: [118.38, 120, 118.39, 118.39, 118.39, 118.39] - Catalog outlier confirmed.
At W=1440/1920 computed grid-template-columns='136px 136px 136px 136px 136px 136px' as expected (fixed track sizing used instead of 1fr; still equal and matches spec of ~136px).
Active indicator left is ~1.3px off active tab left after click; could use Math.round or exact rect copy for pixel-perfect alignment.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (7/8 width breakpoints fully pass; 1 minor off-by-1.62px)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only remaining issue is Catalog tab 1.62px wider than siblings at exactly W=768. All other widths and layouts (grid at >=1281 with 136px columns, flex equal at 900/1100/1280, mobile equal at 360/390) pass. Indicator and click switching work. Reproduce with widths list [768] after cache-bust.
